name: sauce-demo-e2e
description: Automatización E2E de Sauce Demo usando Cypress con POM

scripts.test: rm -rf cypress/reports/* && npx cypress run --spec "cypress/e2e/sauceDemo.spec.js" --reporter junit --reporter-options mochaFile=cypress/reports/junit/results-[hash].xml,toConsole=true && node scripts/report-html.js
